title: Storyboard selected image and approval recover exactly after restart
situation: The Human saves and locks an exact Storyboard image in an authenticated profile, then ends and restarts PlotPickle and reopens the same story.
businessReason: Repeated apparently successful Save/Lock changes have left the Human unsure whether approved media survives restart and feeds Previs correctly. The human promise must outrank code and implementation-authored tests.

humanJourney.action: Authenticate in a test-scoped profile; open a story and identify a selected Storyboard artifact and version.
Before any confirmed Save, try the actual Lock control: it must be unavailable with a clear reason and must not commit approval, including via direct command.
Press actual Storyboard Save; compare selected artifact/version/digest and observe pending then independently acknowledged durable commit.
Only after independently confirmed Save of the exact selected version, press actual Lock for that version and verify committed approval.
Stop the running application process, restart it and reopen the same project with changes.
Compare recovered media digest, artifact identity, version, visible Save/Lock badges and project scope against the known pre-restart values.
Confirm downstream Previs reads the same durably saved-and-locked artifact, not a stale candidate.

preconditions: Proposed and awaiting Human approval: supported normal same-device restart, same authenticated Human and project, required media and encrypted storage accessible.
Known reversible non-sensitive test media and test-scoped profile; do not alter real Human content.
Observed environment, contract version and git revision recorded.
expectedOutcome: Lock is not permitted until the exact selected artifact/version has a confirmed durable Save; only actual durable persistence and approval yield Saved and Locked claims; the exact artifact identity, bytes/digest, version and approval return after restart, unrelated identities remain unchanged, and Previs sees only the same approved version.

requiredEvidence.description: Known digest, media identity, artifact revision, selected shot, project and scoped profile before Save.
Actual Lock control and underlying command reject attempts before confirmed exact-version Save, including pending/rejected/unknown states and stale selection; no approval mutation.
Independent authenticated read of exact persisted artifact and approval, not only a handler or UI flag.
Actual rendered Save and Lock controls show truthful status and version after acknowledgement and recovery.
Actual process ended and new process recovered the exact media and approval state.
Unrelated artifact/project/profile snapshots remain unchanged without authorized actions.
Previs input corresponds to the exact saved-and-locked artifact version.
Injected write denial and uncertain acknowledgement never create false success or discard unsaved work.

independentVerification.proves: An observer holding the pre-save expected image digest and approval state independently reads real backing storage and reopened rendered UI after a genuine process restart; simulated verification must be labelled insufficient for actual Windows acceptance.

knownRisks: media file missing although metadata says saved
Lock allowed on unsaved or pending selection because of stale UI saved marker or stale operation acknowledgement
injectedFailureModes: Attempt Lock on unsaved, pending, unknown, rejected or stale-selected version; assert no approval side effect
Commit succeeds but network acknowledgement is lost
Old version acknowledgement arrives after new edit
Repeated same operation with same digest; conflicting reuse with different digest
Stale revision and locked/unlocked racing update
Attempt read/write under different authenticated profile
Restart after Save and Lock; verify media identity and approval
Unavailable local media despite Saved metadata
Unload while write pending, assessed after Human chooses policy
authorityBoundaries: Human-approved business truth is authoritative; proposed interpretation is not yet approved.
Use current existing storage/project/profile/DSDD/Casebook owners; no new authoritative state manager.
Do not change real personal projects, keys, credentials, media or perform paid generation.
A simulated or mocked test cannot be reported as proven real Windows application restart.
Lock approval and media Save are separate; neither may falsely imply the other.
No merge changing approved semantics without recorded Human approval.
successCriteria: Human has confirmed Save-before-Lock ordering; Human approves the remaining recovery scope and pending/unload policy before the full contract is binding.
Actual UI and domain logic prevent Lock before confirmed durable Save of the exact selected artifact/version.
Actual rendered interface and encrypted backing store prove Saved and Locked outcomes under defined conditions.
Actual process restart recovers identical media identity/digest and approved lock.
No unrelated artifact/profile changes, duplicates or false Saved/Locked claims in observed fault sequences.
Previs consumes the identical saved-and-locked selected artifact version.
Evidence records PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED/UNPROVEN scope; green build is not a substitute.
quantitativeMeasurements: Number of false Saved or Locked claims
Number of duplicate artifact/resource writes per retry
Unexpected changes to other artifact/project/profile identities
Elapsed time from approved truth to independently verified user outcome
verificationImplementationStatus: not implemented; this is a proposed Casebook-compatible definition, not a passing case

formalConstraints.property: AllowedLock(identity,version,digest) implies ConfirmedDurableCommit(same identity,version,digest). DisplayLocked implies both ConfirmedDurableCommit and ConfirmedDurableApproval for same selected version; Lock requires commit, not optimistic saved marker.
Save/Lock/Unlock of selected artifact preserves all unrelated durable media and approvals; Unlock does not erase Save
Same operation identifier+same version+same digest has one durable effect; same identifier+different payload rejects
Old expected revision may not overwrite newer accepted revision
Confirmed Save+Lock survives a supported process restart and exact scoped project recovery
Previs approved artifact requires matching durable saved media and durable lock
Under declared available dependencies Save reaches verified commit or explicit rejection; uncertainty has reconciliation

humanConfirmedDecisions.originalIntent: You can't lock unless it has been saved. And then, then you can lock.
humanConfirmedDecisions.effect: Lock unavailable until exact selected image/version has confirmed durable Save. A Saved version may be Locked only after Save completion; rejected, unknown, pending and unsaved versions cannot be Locked. Previs requires both.
